tools.name: get_compliance_rules
tools.description: Returns the workspace's secure-coding rules: what to look for, how to fix it, and the ISO 27001 Annex A controls and DPDP Act sections each rule evidences. Call this before reviewing a change, then report with report_compliance_check.

tools.name: report_compliance_check
tools.description: Turns the check you ran against the rules from get_compliance_rules into a scorecard: findings by severity, the ISO 27001 controls and DPDP Act sections affected, and the fix for each. Report a clean check too. Regulane does not store it. Send no source code, secrets or personal data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_compliance_check" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
